message: No detected input validation: The code reads DICOM files and splits/parses text lines without any schema, dtype, or value-range validation on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication present in the code.

No detected label flipping detection: Labels are simply assigned incrementally from directory enumeration with no validation against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool is used.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code only splits and writes file paths; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious samples applied to the training data.
No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained weights are loaded via `models.{}(pretrained=pretrained)` through torchvision without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.

No detected label distribution validation: The code performs a simple train/test split and writes label files but never checks class balance, verifies the expected label set, or flags anomalous samples before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection is present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Adam/RAdam optimizers with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress-testing in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code splits data into train/valid but there is no isolated held-out test set, no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and only standard metrics (precision/recall/F1, confusion matrix) are computed without independent verification mechanisms.

No detected input sanitization: The dataset/__getitem__ reads DICOM files and applies preprocessing/resizing, but there are no shape, range, or schema validation checks on incoming inference inputs before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the provided inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibration thresholds before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a medical image classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
